notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to the Ayyub b. Nuh book, with no saying (rule 11). Read as written: أبي and محمد بن الحسن are co-transmitters to سعد بن عبد الله and الحميري («جميعا»), who both report from أيوب بن نوح. «رضي اللّه عنهما» is left out; a ruling is needed on whether a route statement is stored as a chain.
